fields.FIR_Description: On 2026-02-23 at roughly 06:15, it was reported that a black smartphone was allegedly snatched from the hand of the complainant at Nila Nagar Bus Stand Area in Chennai by a person who left quickly. A further person, Venkat Palanisamy, an intermediary, using the number 9000000134, is stated to be associated with the incident. A witness, Kishore Muthu, reachable on 9000000320, was mentioned in the complaint. A person named Bharath Balan, associated with the number 9000000047, was mentioned as potentially relevant to the incident.
fields.Evidence_Mentioned: Photograph; Mobile phone record; Call detail reference
fields.Modus_Operandi: Handset reportedly snatched while the victim was using it near the roadside.
fields.Keywords: mobile theft, smartphone, photograph, witness, phone records, associate, early morning, mobile number
